how: Antigravity started in the e2e deck against the fake model with each --mode, read at its idle prompt before any turn (120x40) as the input-box probe does (`rows`, `bright` where dim cells blank some, `cursor`, and the style runs of each row), then with the word `hello` typed. In accept-edits and plan modes the empty box holds a hint, `<Mode> mode: ... (shift+tab to cycle)`, in palette colour 8 (grey), not SGR dim, so `bright` keeps it, with the cursor at the box's start; typing replaces it. Default and auto modes show none.
